booleanization.threshold: MFSC: streaming dynamic mean per coefficient over the last 64 frames (division by shift); SF: fixed threshold 1024
booleanization.description: Each of the 64 coefficients per frame becomes one bit: MFSC bits compare against a running per-coefficient average over a 64-frame batch (updated in streaming fashion), SF bits against a fixed threshold of 1024; feature map 64 coefficients x 64 frames, scanned by a 64x7 spectral convolution kernel (58 windows).

notes: Hardware: TSMC 65 nm LP; the paper calls Fig. 16(b) 'measurement results' and power 'measured' at 1.2 V/25 C (no low-voltage library), but the layout is 'exported from Cadence Virtuoso' and it never says the chip was fabricated, so whether figures are silicon measurements or post-layout simulation is unclear. The 0.7 V numbers (16.58 uW total, 11.94 uW inference core) are voltage-scaled estimates (dynamic ~ V^2, static ~ V). Accuracy: the paper does not say whether 87.35% was measured on chip or in software; Fig. 7 caption calls it 'measured accuracy' alongside 200/400-clause models that were never put on chip, and the software MFSC-SF preprocessing is 'designed to ensure numerical consistency with its hardware counterpart', which suggests a bit-exact software evaluation; recorded as implementation not_reported. Latency 16 ms = one 256-sample subframe at 16 kHz. Training library not named. The 64x16 TA action matrix per clause = 64 rows x (7 kernel columns x 2 polarities + positional TAs), positional encoding details not given. Validation set (4490) exists but its use is not stated; the split counts are not called official. Fig. 7 values exist only as figure data labels; series assignment taken from the text layer order. Prior vanilla-TM KWS results quoted in Sec. I (86.5%/80.5% 6/9 keywords [12], REDRESS 87.1% [13]) are on different tasks and not in the record.
